decisions.decision: The Committee felt the Board of Selectmen's inquiries about the FY15 Capital Plan were premature because the Plan is not yet finalized and the Town Manager has not presented the final budget.
decisions.quote: the committee felt his inquiries were premature as the plan is not yet finalized

decisions.decision: Senior Center Sprinkler reprioritized from #18 to #11.
decisions.quote: senior center sprinkler reprioritized from #18 to #11.

decisions.decision: Fire Dept. Car 2 reprioritized from #11 to #17.
decisions.quote: fire dept. car 2 will be reprioritized from #11 to #17.

decisions.decision: Priority groups set: Priority 1 is #1 through #10, Priority 2 is #11 through #16, Priority 3 is #17 through #23.
The Committee supported the Marshall Park parking lot from a safety point of view.
decisions.quote: the committee supported the parking lot from a safety point of view.

decisions.decision: M. Benson is to send an email to K. Speidel noting the Committee needs an analysis for outsourcing the Sweeper.
decisions.quote: m. benson to send email to k. speidel noting committee needs an analysis for outsourcing the sweeper.

decisions.decision: Committee wants a firm quote on the Sweeper and the cost of privatization, with the DPW Director to provide analysis over the ensuing year; the Sweeper stays as is this year.
decisions.quote: committee wants a firm quote on sweeper and also cost of privatization.

decisions.decision: K. Speidel to check with the Police and Fire Chiefs about Marshall Park from a safety standpoint.
decisions.quote: k. speidel to check with police and fire chief re marshall park from a safety standpoint.

decisions.decision: The Committee asked that the Plan note why road paving is not on the FY15 prioritization, acknowledging it is a high priority with no way to fund it under current constraints.
decisions.quote: k. speidel requests the committee note on the prioritization why the pavement was not on fy15 plan.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: K. Speidel gave the cost of outsourcing the sweeper work, noting in-house or outsourced cost would be the same.

budget_items.topic: Capital funding level and Fire Dept. Engine 1 financing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of funding $750,000 in the operating budget for capital instead of $500,000, and financing the fire truck over 5 years.
budget_items.quote: if the truck is financed over 5 years, it would be approximately $125,000/yr.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: K. Speidel contemplated removing the Sweeper and Engine 1 from the Capital Plan and borrowing for both together.
budget_items.quote: k. speidel contemplated taking both the sweeper and engine 1 out of the capital plan and borrowing at $165,000 together.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Tech request at priority #15 would be deferred if not funded, and the IT Director felt he could manage for one year.
budget_items.quote: if the $14,400 in town tech, priority #15, is not funded

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The remaining Town Hall amount on the Plan is half of a two-year request and would go away if significant renovations are done.
budget_items.quote: the $40,000 left on the plan is ½ of a two -year 40-40 request.

budget_items.topic: Savings from removing items from the Plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Removing Car 2, Marshall Park, Town Hall, THMS Shade Structure and Police Dept. Speed Sign from the Plan would save a stated amount.
Committee reviewed option totals, including the total if Car 2 and Marshall Park were put back in.
budget_items.quote: if car 2 and marshall park put back in would total $747,000.

budget_items.topic: Total capital with cash and debt service
budget_items.what_was_recorded: K. Speidel noted the $750,000 figure would include both cash and debt service.
budget_items.quote: k. speidel noted the $750,000 would include both cash and debt service.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Suggestion to note on the Plan that $125,000 comes out of the operating budget for roads.
budget_items.quote: possibly note on the plan that $125,000 comes out of operating budget for roads?
